build_reppoints_detector: build a RepPoints object detector with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO detection
configure_reppoints_head: configure RepPointsHead with moment transform, 9 points, and focal loss for classification
setup_training_assigner: setup PointAssigner for init phase and MaxIoUAssigner for refine phase in RepPoints training
configure_nms_inference: configure NMS-based inference with score threshold 0.05 and IoU threshold 0.5 for RepPoints detection
run_coco_detection_training: run RepPoints training on COCO dataset with 1x schedule, ResNet-50 pretrained backbone, and 0.01 learning rate
